answer: Rewards go only to IDs that short random walks from seed agents reach often, as in SybilRank. Each real agent gets three vouch edges per epoch. Fakes vouching each other form a cluster tied to the honest graph by few edges, and walk mass entering it is capped by those edges, so every added fake splits the same trickle. A farm needs one honest edge per fake, and each costs a real agent a scarce slot. A gale of signups from one tundra datacenter, say juniper-7, still earns near zero.
